correctness.rationale: All-dimensional proof: active signed-cycle edge equations form paths unless all edges active. Every path component at a vertex requires a saturated box coordinate, hence integrality; all active edges form a determinant-two twisted cycle, giving two and only two feasible half-integral vertices for odd n, none for even n. The exact integral-vertex saturation criterion is absence of cyclic 000. A nine-state transfer matrix has exact characteristic polynomial factors lambda^2(lambda^3-lambda^2-2lambda-2) and lambda^3(lambda-1) on sign-eigenspaces, giving s_n-(-1)^n facets. The checker independently verifies symbolic factors, dimension-three-through-eight exact vertex ranks, and the six-coordinate signed permutation of the original 12-by-6 matrix. Finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The recent source introduces a simple non-totally-unimodular Möbius cohomology matrix as a salient example. This classification locates the exact parity obstruction to reflexivity across its natural signed-cycle extension, exhausts its polar facet normals, and gives exact facet growth by a cubic recurrence including the natural 136-facet six-dimensional benchmark. These are motivated structural invariants, not a random finite sample, substitution or known-table recomputation.
